source_text.body:
Control Chrome with Claude on a restricted work computer
A user runs Claude in Chrome on a work machine where Claude Code and the desktop app can't be installed, using it to handle everyday browser tasks.
·
Nov 13, 2026
Done with
CH
Claude in Chrome
CL
Claude
What they did
The user used the Claude Chrome extension on a locked-down work computer where they could not install Claude Code or the desktop app. Inside that browser session, Claude handled routine web tasks such as copying data from one sheet into weekly forms and managing fantasy football lineups, while the person limited access with a separate Chrome profile and still reviewed actions like final clicks.
How it went
They said it completely eliminated about an hour a week of repetitive copy-paste work. In the thread they also said the browser control had been poor when it first launched but had improved a lot recently.
Worth knowing
The main catch mentioned was security: they suggest a separate Chrome profile so Claude only sees the sites you want it to access.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
I'm working on a locked-down computer where I can only use the browser. Help me with these everyday tasks in Chrome: [describe tasks, e.g. sort through my inbox and summarize unread emails, fill in a timesheet at [site], gather info from [websites] into a short summary]. Work through them one at a time and tell me what you did after each. Pause and show me before you send any message, submit any form, or delete anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xvkiit/claude_fomo_is_real_what_are_you_doing_with
